approach: Reference design for XML Document Management and Transformation Platform: begin with synthetic data and a written contract, then create the smallest valid document/schema/stylesheet needed for the required features. Add tests for valid, malformed and boundary input. Develop a local platform concept for importing XML documents, inspecting structure, validating against XSD, querying with namespace-aware XPath, transforming with XSLT, and generating standardized error reports.
key_decisions: Keep source documents and expected outputs in version control.
Validate output using the exact schema/processor intended for deployment.
Block unnecessary external-resource resolution and bound document size/depth.
Record namespace, encoding, processor version, compatibility, and known limitations.
acceptance_criteria: XSLT transformation to HTML/text or supported output
Technical documentation and reproducible local workflow
explanation: This is a reference design rather than a claim that the project was deployed or run. Equivalent solutions are acceptable if they satisfy the acceptance criteria and provide evidence for expected behavior.
